description: This file implements a web services class ('SugarWebServiceImpl') for SuiteCRM, providing methods for CRUD operations, relationship management, user authentication, and system info retrieval via SOAP API.

classes.name: SugarWebServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation class providing SOAP web service methods for SuiteCRM, including CRUD operations, relationships, user login/logout, system info, and search functions.

methods.name: get_entry
methods.description: Retrieves a single SugarBean record based on ID, delegating to get_entries.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Retrieves multiple SugarBean records based on IDs, handles access checks, loads beans, and returns structured data.

methods.name: get_entry_list
methods.description: Returns a list of SugarBeans matching a query, with support for pagination and link fields.

methods.name: set_relationship
methods.description: Creates or deletes a relationship between two beans identified by module and ID.

methods.name: set_relationships
methods.description: Creates or deletes multiple relationships across multiple modules and beans.

methods.name: get_relationships
methods.description: Retrieves related beans and relationship data for a given bean and relationship link.

methods.name: set_entry
methods.description: Updates or creates a single bean, applying provided field values.

methods.name: set_entries
methods.description: Bulk creates or updates a list of beans.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user and starts a session, returning session details and user info.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Ends the user session and cleans up.

methods.name: get_server_info
methods.description: Returns server version, flavor, and current GMT time.

methods.name: get_user_id
methods.description: Returns user ID of the currently logged-in session.

methods.name: get_module_fields
methods.description: Retrieves vardef (field) info for a module, respecting ACL permissions.

methods.name: seamless_login
methods.description: Performs internal check if session is authenticated; used for sync process.

methods.name: set_note_attachment
methods.description: Uploads an attachment to a note and optionally links it to a module.

methods.name: get_note_attachment
methods.description: Retrieves an attachment from a note, with access check.

methods.name: set_document_revision
methods.description: Uploads or updates a document revision with a new file.

methods.name: get_document_revision
methods.description: Downloads a document revision's file content.

methods.name: search_by_module
methods.description: Performs a search across specified modules with the search string; supports pagination.

methods.name: get_available_modules
methods.description: Returns modules accessible to the current user.

methods.name: set_campaign_merge
methods.description: Registers targets and campaign ID after a mail merge for tracking.

methods.name: get_entries_count
methods.description: Returns total record count for a module based on optional query and deleted flag.
